title: 制作与资源链
markdown:
# 制作与资源链 ## 核心概念 **制作系统（Crafting System）**是游戏经济中的生产层：玩家将原材料通过配方转化为更高价值的成品。从系统工程角度看，制作系统构成一个**有向无环图（DAG）**，其中节点是物品，边是配方。这个 DAG 的拓扑结构决定了资源链的深度、瓶颈位置和价格传导路径。 ```mermaid graph LR A[铁矿石
掉落率: 15%] --> B[铁锭
配方: 2矿→1锭] C[煤炭
掉落率: 10%] --> B B --> D[铁剑
配方: 3锭→1剑] B --> E[铁甲
配方: 8锭→1甲] F[皮革
掉落率: 20%] --> G[皮革护甲
配方: 5皮→1甲] H[魔法晶石
掉落率: 0.5%] --> I[附魔铁剑
配方: 1剑+2晶] D --> I ``` | 分析维度 | 含义 | 工程问题 | | ----------------- | ---------------------- | -------------------------- | | DAG 深度 | 从原材料到成品的层数 | 深度越大，价格传导链越长 | | 汇聚点（Fan-in） | 多种原材料汇入同一成品 | 任一原材料稀缺会阻塞整条链 | | 分叉点（Fan-out） | 一种材料被多种配方使用 | 竞争需求会推高原材料价格 | | 瓶颈节点 | 供给最受约束的材料 | 决定整条链的产出上限 | ## 制作 DAG 建模 ```python from dataclasses import dataclass, field from typing import Optional import networkx as nx import numpy as np @dataclass class Item: item_id: str name: str base_drop_rate: float = 0.0 # 原材料掉落率（终端节点） crafting_recipe: Optional[dict] = None # {ingredient_id: quantity} craft_output_qty: int = 1 # 制作产出数量 @property def is_raw_material(self) -> bool: return self.crafting_recipe is None class CraftingDAG: """制作系统有向无环图""" def __init__(self): self.graph = nx.DiGraph() self.items: dict[str, Item] = {} def add_item(self, item: Item): self.items[item.item_id] = item self.graph.add_node(item.item_id, item=item) if item.crafting_recipe: for ingredient_id, qty in item.crafting_recipe.items(): self.graph.add_edge( ingredient_id, item.item_id, quantity=qty, output=item.craft_output_qty ) def validate_dag(self) -> bool: """验证图无环（防止循环配方导致无限产出）""" return nx.is_directed_acyclic_graph(self.graph) def get_raw_materials_needed(self, item_id: str, target_qty: int = 1) -> dict: """ 递归展开：生产 target_qty 个 item_id 需要多少原材料？ 返回 {raw_material_id: total_quantity_needed} """ if item_id not in self.items: raise ValueError(f"Unknown item: {item_id}") item = self.items[item_id] if item.is_raw_material: return {item_id: target_qty} # 需要制作 ceil(target_qty / craft_output_qty) 批 batches_needed = -(-target_qty // item.craft_output_qty) # ceiling division total_raws = {} for ingredient_id, qty_per_batch in item.crafting_recipe.items(): ingredient_total = batches_needed * qty_per_batch sub_raws = self.get_raw_materials_needed( ingredient_id, ingredient_total ) for raw_id, raw_qty in sub_raws.items(): total_raws[raw_id] = total_raws.get(raw_id, 0) + raw_qty return total_raws def compute_production_cost(self, item_id: str, target_qty: int, market_prices: dict[str, float]) -> dict: """计算制作成本（按当前市价）""" raw_materials = self.get_raw_materials_needed(item_id, target_qty) total_cost = sum( raw_materials.get(raw_id, 0) * market_prices.get(raw_id, 0) for raw_id in raw_materials ) cost_per_unit = total_cost / target_qty return { "total_cost": total_cost, "cost_per_unit": cost_per_unit, "raw_materials_needed": raw_materials, "breakdown": { raw_id: qty * market_prices.get(raw_id, 0) for raw_id, qty in raw_materials.items() } } ``` ## 资源汇总表（Bill of Materials） 制作 BOM（Bill of Materials）是制作系统的完整展开表： ```python def build_bom_table(dag: CraftingDAG, item_id: str, market_prices: dict) -> list[dict]: """ 生成完整 BOM 表：每层的中间产品和最终原材料需求 """ bom = [] def traverse(current_id: str, qty_needed: int, depth: int = 0): item = dag.items.get(current_id) if not item: return market_price = market_prices.get(current_id, 0) row = { "depth": depth, "item_id": current_id, "item_name": item.name, "quantity_needed": qty_needed, "is_raw_material": item.is_raw_material, "unit_market_price": market_price, "subtotal_cost": qty_needed * market_price, } bom.append(row) if not item.is_raw_material: batches = -(-qty_needed // item.craft_output_qty) for ing_id, ing_qty in item.crafting_recipe.items(): traverse(ing_id, batches * ing_qty, depth + 1) traverse(item_id, 1) return bom ``` ## 瓶颈分析 瓶颈是整条制作链中供给最受约束的材料，决定了链的最终产出上限： ```python def identify_bottlenecks( dag: CraftingDAG, item_id: str, market_prices: dict, active_players: int, sessions_per_day: float ) -> list[dict]: """ 识别制作链瓶颈： 1. 计算每个原材料的需求量 2. 估算每日供给量（掉落率 × 玩家数） 3. 找出供给/需求比最低的材料 """ raw_materials_needed = dag.get_raw_materials_needed(item_id) bottleneck_analysis = [] for raw_id, qty_needed in raw_materials_needed.items(): raw_item = dag.items.get(raw_id) if not raw_item: continue # 估算每日供给 daily_supply = (raw_item.base_drop_rate * active_players * sessions_per_day * 10) # 假设每局10次击杀机会 # 供需比：< 1 表示供给不足 supply_demand_ratio = daily_supply / qty_needed if qty_needed > 0 else float('inf') bottleneck_analysis.append({ "item_id": raw_id, "item_name": raw_item.name, "quantity_needed_for_1_craft": qty_needed, "daily_supply_estimate": daily_supply, "supply_demand_ratio": supply_demand_ratio, "is_bottleneck": supply_demand_ratio < 1.5, "severity": ( "CRITICAL" if supply_demand_ratio < 0.5 else "HIGH" if supply_demand_ratio < 1.0 else "MEDIUM" if supply_demand_ratio < 1.5 else "OK" ), "unit_price": market_prices.get(raw_id, 0), "cost_contribution": (qty_needed * market_prices.get(raw_id, 0)) }) return sorted(bottleneck_analysis, key=lambda x: x["supply_demand_ratio"]) def analyze_price_propagation( dag: CraftingDAG, shocked_item_id: str, # 哪个原材料价格发生冲击 price_shock_pct: float, # 价格冲击幅度（如 0.5 = 涨价 50%） market_prices: dict, target_items: list[str] # 需要分析影响的成品 ) -> dict: """分析原材料价格冲击对成品成本的传导""" original_prices = market_prices.copy() shocked_prices = market_prices.copy() shocked_prices[shocked_item_id] = (market_prices[shocked_item_id] * (1 + price_shock_pct)) results = {} for target_id in target_items: original_cost = dag.compute_production_cost( target_id, 1, original_prices )["cost_per_unit"] shocked_cost = dag.compute_production_cost( target_id, 1, shocked_prices )["cost_per_unit"] results[target_id] = { "original_cost": original_cost, "shocked_cost": shocked_cost, "cost_increase_pct": (shocked_cost - original_cost) / original_cost if original_cost > 0 else 0 } return results ``` ## 小结 - 制作系统构成一个 DAG，拓扑结构（深度/汇聚/分叉）决定了价格传导路径和瓶颈位置 - `get_raw_materials_needed` 递归展开 DAG，计算制作任意数量成品需要的最终原材料总量 - BOM（Bill of Materials）表是制作系统的可视化分析工具，用于预算成本和识别高成本组件 - 瓶颈分析通过比较供需比识别「最薄弱的一环」：供需比 < 1.5 的材料需要关注 - 价格传导分析量化原材料价格冲击对成品成本的影响比例，是调整掉率决策的依据
